title: ParliamentRAG Knowledge Graph - Italian Parliament (Chamber of Deputies and Senate), 19th Legislature (RDF export)
description:
RDF export of the ParliamentRAG knowledge graph covering both houses of the Italian Parliament, the Chamber of Deputies and the Senate, in the 19th legislature: people (deputies, senators, government members), parliamentary groups, committees, acts, EuroVoc topics, sittings, debates, full speech transcripts, roll-call votes and {{INDIVIDUAL_VOTES}} individual votes.

Two files:

  • parliamentrag_kg.ttl (Turtle): the structural KG, {{TRIPLES}} triples;
  • parliamentrag_votes.nt (N-Triples): the individual vote cast by each member in every electronic ballot of both houses.

Ontology alignment: OCD (dati.camera.it), OSR (dati.senato.it), FOAF, W3C ORG, SKOS (EuroVoc), PROV-O, plus a small project namespace (https://w3id.org/parliamentrag/ontology#) for debate-structure terms aligned to Akoma Ntoso. Each sitting carries its chamber (pr:chamber). Members keep their official URIs from dati.camera.it or dati.senato.it, with owl:sameAs links when a person sat in both houses or in the government. Embeddings, retrieval chunks, user conversations and AI-generated summaries are not part of the export.

Source data: open data of the Chamber of Deputies (dati.camera.it, CC BY-SA 4.0), of the Senate (dati.senato.it, CC BY 3.0) and the EuroVoc thesaurus of the EU Publications Office. The derived graph is released under CC BY-SA 4.0, as the ShareAlike clause of the Chamber data requires. Versions before this one covered the Chamber of Deputies only.

Companion system described in: Tritella, Pozzi, Palmonari, "Who Speaks Matters: Authority-Aware Multi-View RAG over Italian Parliamentary Proceedings", The Semantic Web - ISWC 2026, doi:10.1007/978-3-032-42029-9_24. Source code: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23173703.
